claims.claim_text: Technical Steering Committee 已有 Amazon、Cursor、Microsoft、OpenAI、Vercel，Google 以 Kevin Hou 為代表加入
claims.evidence: It was published by a TSC of Core Maintainers from Amazon, Cursor, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Vercel. Google is joining that group as a Core Maintainer, represented by Kevin Hou.
claims.note: Org list and representative name both match verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 安裝機制、散布協定、權限模型、sandbox 要求全部留給 client 決定，寫進 future considerations
claims.evidence: The specification defines no install mechanism, no distribution protocol, no permission model, no sandboxing requirements... named openly in the projects future considerations, not quietly omitted.
claims.note: Sources omission list is a superset; the posts four items are all present.

claims.claim_text: MCP server 明確標出 stdio、HTTP 或 HTTP+SSE 的 transport
claims.evidence: A client never has to guess a transport from the shape of a config object, it will work on stdio, Streamable HTTP, or legacy HTTP+SSE.
claims.note: Post compresses Streamable HTTP to HTTP; no meaning change.

claims.claim_text: 8 月 5 日公布，由五個 team 近期採納，範圍只涵蓋這一個 repo
claims.evidence: Recently, five teams in the Rust project adopted a policy ... the new policy is _not_ an official stance on LLMs, and does _not_ apply everywhere in the Rust project.
claims.note: Five-teams count and repo-only scope verified. The DATE was not: the source says only Recently, and 2026-08-05 is the posts dateline, not the adoption date. FIXED by the parent: the lede now reads 8 月 5 日公布，由五個 team 近期採納, which restores the sources hedge instead of asserting an adoption date.

claims.claim_text: 當時 1,281 個開著的 PR
claims.evidence: At the time of writing, there are 1,281 open PRs to `rust-lang/rust`.
claims.note: Post mirrors the sources At the time of writing hedge.

claims.claim_text: LLM 可以回答問題、分析、提煉、檢查、建議、審閱，但不能用來創造
claims.evidence: Its fine to use LLMs to answer questions, analyze, distill, refine, check, suggest, review. But not to create.
claims.note: Verb list matches one-to-one; downstream clauses (disclosure, tests, soundness-critical, close without questions) all check out.

claims.evidence: Fast run: 0.050325 seconds / Slow run: 0.725689 seconds
claims.note: Both six-decimal figures verbatim and attached to the same loop.

claims.claim_text: 回程撞上 NYI: return to lower frame
claims.evidence: the new trace has no record of entering the `FRAME_PCALL`, so recording aborts with NYI: return to lower frame
claims.note: Exact abort string present; FRAME_PCALL framing matches.

claims.claim_text: LuaJIT 把 empty_fn 的 bytecode 列入黑名單，付出代價的是呼叫它的熱迴圈
claims.evidence: After enough failed attempts, LuaJIT blacklists empty_fns bytecode, so the hot loop calling it can no longer be JIT-compiled and falls back to the interpreter, even though the loop itself never touches pcall or unpack.
claims.note: The deep-story checker found the causal direction inverted in an earlier draft (post said the pcall-containing bytecode was blacklisted and empty_fn was collateral). The same inversion was present in this roundups hero lede and item-03 lede. FIXED by the parent in both places to match the source: empty_fns own bytecode is blacklisted, so the loop calling it cannot be compiled.

claims.claim_text: ARM gcc 14.2.0 -O2 下 short t = *p 編出 ldrh 與 ldrsh 兩道 load
claims.evidence: ARM gcc 14.2.0 -O2 ... ldrh r2, [r0] / ldrsh r0, [r0] ... One load in the source, two in the binary. The second is an invented load.
claims.note: Compiler, version, flag, source line and both mnemonics all match verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 不是單一編譯器的 bug，而是 rematerialization、寬度不符的重載、bulk 與 scalar 拷貝重疊在 GCC、Clang、MSVC、ICC 上共同浮現
claims.evidence: an emergent property of the whole pipeline, not a bug in any part of it — mechanisms: rematerialization, width-mismatch reload, bulk-vs-scalar overlap... Toolchains affected: GCC, Clang, ICX, ICC, MSVC.
claims.note: Post names a subset of both lists; no overclaim.

claims.claim_text: dictionary 編碼欄位且 series 連續排列下 12.4 到 16.5 倍
claims.evidence: adjacent | 5000x20 | 61.8 ms | 4.98 ms | 12.4x ... adjacent/1000x100: 55.6 ms to 3.38 ms, roughly 16.5x faster
claims.note: 12.4-16.5x is exactly the min/max of the dictionary+adjacent condition; interleaved figures are not smuggled in.

claims.claim_text: 吞吐從約 2M 上到 10 至 35M rows/second
claims.evidence: Throughput went from 1.8M-3.2M rows per second to 9.6M-34.8M, and no case got slower.
claims.note: Rounding within the posts own hedges; the before figure reports only the low end of a 1.8M-3.2M range.

claims.claim_text: 分組是逐 batch 進行，跨 batch 的同一條 series 不會被合併
claims.evidence: Grouping happens batch by batch; `recordbatches_to_timeseries` only flattens the per-batch results, so a series that spans two batches is not merged at this step.
claims.note: The three old-path costs and the LabelValues borrow are also supported.

claims.claim_text: 文章以 Zak van der Merwe 在 EC2 控制平面約十年的第一手經驗展開（Werner Vogels 只寫引言）
claims.evidence: After a decade working on EC2, I formed some strong opinions. ... Zak van der Merwe has spent his entire career at AWS building control planes. ... Ive been working at AWS for nearly fourteen years
claims.note: The decade of first-hand EC2 experience is confirmed, and the first-person voice is guest author Zak van der Merwe, not Werner Vogels. The checker noted the original lede named nobody, leaving a reader who knows the blog to assume Vogels. FIXED by the parent: the lede now names Zak van der Merwe and states Werner Vogels only writes the introduction.

claims.claim_text: static stability：不論控制平面出什麼事，已經在跑的 VM 必須繼續運作
claims.evidence: no matter what happens to the control plane, VMs that are already running need to keep working. We call this static stability.
claims.note: Near-verbatim rendering including the naming of the principle.

claims.claim_text: 把 region 切成各自擁有獨立控制平面與獨立 MySQL 的 AZ、再往內做 cell 分片、read replica 換來 eventual consistency
claims.evidence: we split each AWS region into multiple availability zones (AZs), each with their own independent control plane and separate MySQL databases ... The second phase was internal: we sharded each zone into what we call cells. ... this fleet of read replicas is why the EC2 API is eventually consistent.
claims.note: The manual-patching anecdote also checks out.

claims.claim_text: GCS 每次請求約 30 到 100 毫秒
claims.evidence: GCS delivers 30-100ms per request.
claims.note: Exact range, unit and per-request scoping.

claims.claim_text: 索引 terabytes 產生 gigabytes、索引 petabytes 產生 terabytes
claims.evidence: As a rule of thumb, indexing terabytes produces gigabytes of index; indexing petabytes produces terabytes.
claims.note: The posts 大致是 preserves the rule of thumb hedge.

claims.claim_text: Trino、BigQuery 即使只查一列也得付 job scheduling 與 query planning 的秒級成本
claims.evidence: distributed SQL engines like Trino and BigQuery add seconds of job scheduling and query planning overhead, even for a single-row lookup. They are designed for analytical throughput, not interactive point queries.
claims.note: Both engines named; causal reason matches clause for clause.

claims.claim_text: PageIndex 與 Bloom filter 是機率性的、只能縮小掃描範圍，外部索引才是確定的
claims.evidence: those are probabilistic and narrow a scan. The external index is definitive
claims.note: Multimap-to-file-and-row and ranged-read description also supported.

claims.claim_text: 181,874 筆會議記錄、84,312 個唯一使用者、35,003 個 email 網域
claims.evidence: I queried the Firestore `meetings` collection and saw there were 181,874 meeting records belonging to 84,312 unique users across 35,003 email domains.
claims.note: All three figures verbatim and bound to the correct units; consistent with the hero lede and headline.

claims.claim_text: users、chats、transcripts、recordings 都正確回 403，唯獨 meetings 沒有——授權失效，不是認證失效
claims.evidence: You already do it correctly for every other collection (users, chats, transcripts, clips, recordings, videos, notes, teams, organizations all return 403).
claims.note: Post names four of the nine 403-returning collections — a subset, no overclaim.

claims.claim_text: 從 2026 年 1 月 28 日通報起，到 2026 年 7 月仍未修復
claims.evidence: I reported this on January 28th, 2026. It is now July 2026. Six months later. The Firestore database is still wide open.
claims.note: Volatile status claim, but the lede already carries the dated attribution the timeliness rule asks for.

claims.claim_text: GEM 端到端訓練效率翻倍，MFU 來到 20% 到 25%
claims.evidence: doubled end-to-end (E2E) training efficiency to 20-25% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU)
claims.note: Post attributes explicitly to Meta, matching the single-source vendor provenance.

claims.claim_text: 十二個月內把訓練算力放大四倍，跑在數千張最新世代 GPU 上
claims.evidence: scaling training FLOPs 4x in 12 months ... several thousand of the latest-generation GPUs
claims.note: Matches in magnitude and generation wording.

claims.claim_text: Jagged Flash Attention 最多 50% padding 浪費，v4 相對 v2 TFLOPS 高 40% 到 140%，換算 18.5% 相對 local MFU 增益
claims.evidence: padding to max length could waste up to 50% of compute ... JFA v4 (TLX) achieves 40-140% TFLOPS improvement over JFA v2 ... contributing to 18.5% relative local MFU gain
claims.note: All three figures verbatim; up to 50% hedge preserved; 18.5% correctly scoped to the JFA v4 work.

claims.claim_text: 5D 平行策略對齊 NVLink、區內 RoCE、跨區 RoCE 三層網路
claims.evidence: We use 5D parallelism to scale GEMs training efficiently across thousands of GPUs ... Intra-node NVLink High; FSDP Inter-node (within AI zone) Medium; DDP Inter-node (potentially cross zone) Low (Oversubscribed)
claims.note: 5D parallelism is the sources own term; the three-tier mapping matches the source table row for row.

claims.claim_text: all-gather 佔用的 SM 從 24 降到 1，換得約 5% 端到端 QPS
claims.evidence: reducing SM usage from 24 to 1 for all-gather ... yielding ~5% E2E QPS gain
claims.note: Both verbatim and correctly bound.

claims.claim_text: 先用伺服器渲染與傳統表單寫完，再疊 htmx，理由是不會把自己架進死角
claims.evidence: I find it easiest to write a whole feature without htmx first. This makes sure I dont architect myself into a corner
claims.note: 架進死角 is a direct rendering of architect myself into a corner; kept as the authors own preference.

claims.claim_text: 表單值撐得過一次來回但重新整理就沒了；query string 活得過 reload 與書籤；formaction 可逐顆改變送出目標
claims.evidence: values will disappear if the user reloads the page ... By putting state into the path or query parameters of the page, it will survive across page reloads. It will also survive bookmarking ... you can use submit buttons `formaction` attributes to change the path and query parameters
claims.note: Each of the four sub-claims has its own supporting sentence.

claims.claim_text: 傾向整頁 swap 以避免殘留舊資料，代價是偶爾吃掉輸入，作者認為少見且通常可接受
claims.evidence: Ive often found bugs because a too narrow part of the page was updated, leaving other parts of the page showing stale data. ... sometimes user input will get lost during the swap, but thats rare and usually acceptable.
claims.note: Checked adversarially: the sources literal stated reason is least likely to break, but the stale-data sentence is present verbatim in the same passage and is the bug class motivating the wide swap.
